title: 2.7 Modes of Disease Transmission and Prevention
description: How pathogens spread, the chain of infection and the main prevention measures. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term matches this description? A microorganism capable of causing disease in a host
Which term matches this description? A disease caused by a pathogen that can spread between hosts
Which term matches this description? The spread of a pathogen from one host to another
Which term matches this description? Transmission through physical touching between people
Which term matches this description? Spread through respiratory droplets from coughs or sneezes
Which term matches this description? Spread via tiny particles that remain suspended in air
Which term matches this description? An inanimate object that carries and transfers pathogens
Which term matches this description? An organism that carries a pathogen between hosts
Which term matches this description? An infectious disease transmitted from animals to humans
Which term matches this description? The time between infection and the start of symptoms
Which term matches this description? The time during which an infected person can spread disease
Which term matches this description? Separation of people who may have been exposed to a pathogen
Which term matches this description? Separation of people who are already infected with a disease
Which term matches this description? The administration of a vaccine to produce protective immunity
Which term matches this description? Cleaning hands to remove pathogens and prevent spread
Which term matches this description? The provision of clean water and safe waste disposal
Which term matches this description? Clothing or equipment worn to reduce exposure to pathogens
Which term matches this description? Protection of a population when many people are immune
Which term matches this description? The complete removal or killing of all microbial life
Which term matches this description? The process that kills pathogens on non-living surfaces
